vulnerability_summary: Taylored accepted unauthenticated PayPal webhook bodies that could mark purchases complete and issue download tokens.
causality: Google Jules bot commit c139c021 created the backend template and its /paypal/webhook endpoint, trusted req.body without PayPal signature verification, and generated deployment configuration without PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID. Fix 57b76343 added Webhooks.verifyAndGetWebhookEvent and the required webhook identifier; follow-up 5e5a80b5 wired the identifier into setup. The AI bot authored the same atomic feature containing the vulnerable endpoint.

evidence.ai_binding: The atomic commit author is google-labs-jules[bot] and the commit creates the unauthenticated webhook path.
